release_notes: Attendance app update: every backend action now shows a blocking overlay with a circular progress that turns into a green tick or red cross and clears after 2 seconds. The dashboard clock is 12-hour, check-in and check-out times are much larger, the assigned shift is clearly shown, the face/fingerprint chooser opens instantly from the centre, fingerprint options are hidden on devices without a working sensor, and an open day is no longer counted absent while holiday figures show a dash when the calendar cannot load.
